description: Search Ireland's company register (CRO -- the Companies Registration Office) by the start of a company's current registered name. Returns each match's CRO number, name, status (e.g. Normal/Dissolved/Liquidation), type, registered address and incorporation date. Prefix match only ("Ryanair" finds "RYANAIR DESIGNATED ACTIVITY COMPANY" and "RYANAIR HOLDINGS PUBLIC LIMITED COMPANY" but not "Jet2Ryanair"); case/punctuation-insensitive. The CRO registers the SAME legal entity under slightly different name spellings over time (suffix "LIMITED" vs "LTD", "DESIGNATED ACTIVITY COMPANY" vs "DAC") -- try both forms if a name search comes back thin. Use the returned cro_number with ie_get_company for full detail or ie_get_filings for its filing history.

name.description: Start of the company's current registered name, e.g. "Ryanair".

status.description: Filter to one of the register's own status TEXT values, e.g. "Normal" or "Dissolved" (case-sensitive, as the CRO publishes it). Omit to search across every status.

name: ie_search_companies
title: Ie Search Companies
